lines: We have commenced Project RAT. The rats are to be nourished through an IV in each cage. They do not require exercise. Only their minds matter, the bodies can rot for all it matters. In fact, [SEDATIVE DRUG] is used to keep the rats restrained, and [IMPLANT] has been installed to connect it to the [SURVEILLANCE SYSTEM].
For now, I have been tasked with checking on the rats every hour. The task, although dull, has been proceeding smoothly.
Still, I have observed odd behavior from RAT-8. Whenever I look at it, it backs into a corner and covers its face, like a shy school-girl. The other rats then follow suit...
We will have to investigate further.</size>
